name: facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine/evaluator/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.build_evaluator_with_metrics: build an Evaluator instance from a list of BaseMetric configs to compose multiple metrics
facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.set_dataset_meta: set the dataset_meta property on an Evaluator to propagate meta info to all metrics
facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.process_data_samples: process a batch of BaseDataElement predictions and data through all registered metrics
facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.evaluate_metrics: evaluate all registered metrics and return a dictionary of results with conflict detection
facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.offline_evaluate_predictions: offline evaluate dumped predictions in chunks against validation data and return collected metrics

facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.create_BaseMetric_subclass: create a subclass of BaseMetric implementing process and compute_metrics methods for custom evaluation
facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.use_BaseMetric_evaluate: call evaluate on a BaseMetric instance to collect results and compute metrics across distributed ranks
facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.use_BaseMetric_dataset_meta: set and get dataset_meta property on a BaseMetric instance to pass dataset info to the metric
facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.use_DumpResults_metric: use DumpResults metric to save model predictions to a pickle file for offline evaluation
facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.use_to_cpu_helper: use _to_cpu to recursively transfer tensors and BaseDataElement objects from GPU to CPU

facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.get_metric_value_by_full_name: get the metric value using a full name indicator like 'COCO/AP' from evaluation results
facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.get_metric_value_by_short_name: get the metric value using a short name indicator like 'AP' from evaluation results
facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.test_get_metric_value_exact_match: test get_metric_value with a full name indicator that matches a key in the metrics dict
facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.test_get_metric_value_suffix_match: test get_metric_value with a short name indicator that matches the suffix of a metrics key
facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine.test_get_metric_value_no_match: test get_metric_value raises ValueError when the indicator matches no metrics in the dict
